description: This source file defines the 'TalkAudioPlayer' class, a singleton responsible for managing audio playback functionality, including play, stop, and watchdog mechanisms using AVFoundation's AVAudioPlayer in an asynchronous context.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayer
classes.description: A singleton class for playing audio data asynchronously with watchdog timer and delegate handling.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayer.Playback
classes.description: A private nested class managing synchronization, continuation, and timeout handling for a single playback session.

methods.name: play(data:)
methods.description: Asynchronously plays audio data and returns a result indicating if the playback finished successfully or was interrupted.

methods.name: stop()
methods.description: Stops current playback and returns the current playback time if available.

methods.name: audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_:successfully:)
methods.description: Delegate callback indicating that playback has finished successfully or due to an interruption.

methods.name: stopInternal()
methods.description: Internal method to stop playback without returning a result.

methods.name: finish(playback:result:)
methods.description: Completes the playback process, cancels watchdog, and resumes any awaiting continuation.

methods.name: armWatchdog(playback:)
methods.description: Sets up a watchdog task to monitor playback duration and handle timeout scenarios.
